title: Reviewed alternatives leave scoped d1 attachment misses unresolved
question: Do independently located supplied mentions or a narrower reviewed host population resolve the observed exposed attachment misses?
method: Supply two exact source-located mentions to the retained-source Maverick adapter, and independently reduce the HanLP host alternatives to the reviewed consequent. Ask the same scoped d1 questions under version 2 and inspect their private Reader results separately from the matched comparison.
commands: uv run ci contributions list --run 433 --method extract.pm2_d1 --include-details --include-interpretation --limit 30 --page-bytes 4000000 --json

inputs.role: Independent adjudicated source notes identifying exact referent and host
Supplied-mention source extents and pinned parser request

outputs.role: Completed supplied-mention parser run and cut
Completed d1 diagnostic run and cut
Exact private Reader observations and offered alternatives

conclusion: The native diagnostic settles both requests but still reports no match for the host and missing candidate for the referent. The supplied populations isolate a candidate availability explanation in these scopes without qualifying attachment or modifying ordinary matched results.
